data.fund_type: An open ended equity scheme investing in Healthcare sector
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to seek long term capital appreciation by investing in equity/equity related instruments of companies from the healthcare sector. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equity and Equity related instruments in Healthcare space (including units issued by REITs)  :- 80-100% Equity and equity related instruments other than Healthcare space (including units issued by REITs):- 0-20% Debt & Money Market instruments:- 0-20% Units issued by InvITs:- 0-5% Foreign securities including ADRs / GDRs / Foreign equity and debt securities and Overseas ETFs:- 0-20%
data.exit_load: For redemptions / switch outs (including SIP/STP) within 15 days from the date of allotment of units, irrespective of the amount of investment: 1% No exit load shall be applicable on switches from Regular Plan to Direct Plan and vice versa, under the same scheme.
